model: SDXL base 1.0 + SDXL-Lightning 8-step UNet, scripts/studio/generate_sdxl.py (unpatched, no out-of-memory)

designs.note: Not delivered. Main STAG BEETLE (40510-40512) and backup RHINOCEROS BEETLE (40515-40517) both failed on anatomy, so the prompt was rewritten twice (in jobs files under /tmp, rules10.py left untouched): 'exactly six legs, three on each side' dorsal (40513, 40514) and side view (40518, 40519), then 'legs folded out of sight' dorsal (40530-40533). All 14 images drew 8-12 leg-like limbs, a doubled thorax or segmented leg-like jaws instead of antler mandibles, and several had fake captions and frames. SDXL-Lightning does not count beetle legs; out of time after minute 75.

truth.note: No image has six legs and true stag-beetle mandibles; nothing delivered.

designs.note: One symmetrical moth, four veined wings, two long curling hind-wing tails, furry thorax, ringed abdomen, two antennae; no retouch or crop. 40521 had four extra moths, a frame and fake text; 40522 a long forked abdomen in place of tails.

truth.note: Four wings, two hind-wing tails, one body with head, thorax and abdomen; legs hidden under the body as in a spread specimen seen from above. Antennae drawn thin rather than feathery and eye spots faint, but the long-tailed silhouette is unmistakably Actias luna.
